tasks.title: Fix #btn-pagenumber dual-fire: click plants a stray page-number span AND opens the dialog
tasks.accept: cd apps/web/apps/documenteditor-wysiwyg && node --check editor.js && node pagenumber.test.mjs 2>&1 | grep -q 'PASS' && ! grep -q 'id="btn-pagenumber" data-cmd="insertPageNumber"' index.html && grep -q 'dual-fire' pagenumber.test.mjs
tasks.acceptance_prose: MEASURED DEFECT (recorded in the parity ledger as 'dialog.pagenumber-dialog.l4 declared quirk'): the toolbar button in apps/web/apps/documenteditor-wysiwyg/index.html line 449 is '<button id="btn-pagenumber" data-cmd="insertPageNumber" title="Insert page number field" data-i18n-title="Toolbar.PageNumberTitle" aria-label="Insert page number">#</button>'. It ALSO has a click listener in editor.js (~line 8840, the ['btn-pagenumber', 'pagenumber-dialog'] overlay-wiring table) that opens pagenumber-dialog. So ONE click does BOTH: the generic data-cmd delegation runs the insertPageNumber command (plants a bare inline span.page-number at the caret) AND the dialog opens — the stray span is the bug. FIX: remove ONLY the data-cmd="insertPageNumber" attribute from that button in index.html (keep id, title, data-i18n-title, aria-label exactly as they are — tests pin them). Do NOT touch editor.js. The dialog's Insert button (#btn-pagenumber-ok) and the Ctrl+Shift+P shortcut remain the real insertion paths. VERIFIED FACTS: (1) pagenumber.test.mjs currently pins only 'id="btn-pagenumber"' presence and the ['btn-pagenumber', 'pagenumber-dialog'] wiring — nothing pins data-cmd on the button, so removing it breaks no existing assert. (2) Static tests in this repo use plain src.includes(...) comparisons — NO regex. Then extend apps/web/apps/documenteditor-wysiwyg/pagenumber.test.mjs with an anti-regression pin: assert that the exact string '<button id="btn-pagenumber" data-cmd="insertPageNumber"' does NOT appear in index.html (comment it with 'dual-fire guard'), asserting instead that the button keeps its data-i18n-title. Test files are plain node scripts that end by printing 'PASS' (read the end of the existing file for the exact pattern and copy it). Commit with message 'fix: btn-pagenumber dual-fire — strip data-cmd, dialog is the only insertion path'.
